text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for showing me around today!
I'm really looking forward to Pokke-san's recommended gourmet.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ou~. What was that thing you're on the committee for again,
a racetrack Gourmet Fair?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The hype during races gets crazy hot, ya know.
Lots of folks'll be craving cold stuff, so this oughta be perfect, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Mm, delicious...! No wonder there's a line.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Told ya so! It only opened recently,
but it blew up in popularity in no time.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Yay, triple scoop!!
Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Man
text_block_list.text:
Ouch, what's with this brat――Aagh!?
You got ice cream on me!
This shirt was expensive, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Why you punk...――Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, little guy? Can you stand up?
If you'd like, why don't we split mine?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Mister, you're welcome to join us too.
The treats here are super delicious.
And while we're at it, let's clean that stain off your clothes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Calmed Man
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh... Well, yeah, I guess...
It's not like the ice cream did anything wrong...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, guess there was no need for me to step in.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――Hey, this flavor's pretty wicked too!
Let's all dig in together!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wow...! Gentil-san, you always have tea time
at such a lovely place like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is quite an elegant establishment, is it not?
The coffee is delicious as well.

text_block_list.name: New Customer
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, thought this was a classy joint, but they got students here too~?
This ain't a fast food joint, ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I guess I stretched myself a bit trying to be grown-up!
Mister, what are you having over there?

text_block_list.name: New Customer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A-Ah, well,
this is cheese and fig pintxos...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so stylish...! I wonder if there'd be
demand for something like this at the racetrack too.

text_block_list.name: New Customer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, at the racetrack? Snacking on something like this
while watching the races would feel pretty luxurious!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Hoho.
How very like you, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A Gourmet Fair, you say... What a splendid endeavor.
If only my information could be of even the slightest help.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Your cooperation is deeply appreciated!
As expected of Journey-san's recommendation,
this shop is exceedingly popular.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for the long wait.
However, it should be about time――
...No, will it still take a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Rude Customer
text_block_list.text:
What's the big deal, I'm starving here!
Hurry up and seat me already!

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry!
We are currently full at the moment, so if you could just wait a little—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Buena-san, if you'd like, we can wait on that bench over there until they call our—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, mister, would you like to share a table with us?

text_block_list.name: Rude Customer
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're super hungry, right?
I was thinking if we shared a table, you might be able to sit down sooner... What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Rude Customer
text_block_list.text: ...O-Oh. Well... sure...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon while having a meal at a popular restaurant.
For some reason, an academy student at the next table started sharing a seat with a rather rough-looking customer...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So delicious~!
It's nice and warm... It really soothes the soul, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Rude Customer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it is... Somehow, it really calms you down.
Eating warm food like this... you know...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, indeed.
The power of good food is truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I always thought she lived dangerously...
But perhaps when purity is dialed to its absolute limit, one has no enemies at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The details were unclear... but Buena Vista's natural aura seemed to have completely softened the atmosphere.
Feeling relieved, I turned back to finish my own meal.
